remaining: Thom isomorphism, Thom forms, Euler class of an oriented bundle and integration along the fibre (NS §2.7 Thm 2.94-2.99, Meinrenken §8) are not taught; listed in requires as specialised, pointing to Bott-Tu Ch. I §6, NS §2.7, Meinrenken §8 and curvature-forms. Readers of NS Thm 3.28 with non-isolated fixed components need them.

Localisation is proved only for circle actions on surfaces with isolated fixed points; the general ABBV/Berline-Vergne theorem (higher dimension, fixed components, equivariant Euler class of the normal bundle) is stated with references (Libine Thm 46, NS Thm 3.28, Meinrenken Thm 9.1). Libine's PDF text extraction ended before the final Stokes step of his proof, so that step on this page is our own (standard) argument.

The fact that invariant forms compute de Rham cohomology for compact connected G (averaging), and Cartan's theorem identifying the Cartan model with Borel cohomology, are not proved (stated with references).

KSV §4 uses the Hodge filtration F^0, absolute Hodge/motivated cycles, André motives and Tannakian formalism; these are beyond this page (Hodge filtration pointed to hodge-theory). The uniformisation z -> (wp, wp') of the elliptic curve and the description of c_X as integration of algebraic forms are taken as given.

Meinrenken's isolated-fixed-point formula in Remark 9.4 was partly garbled in text extraction; the conventions row cites only the sign (-1)^{dim M/2}, the absence of an explicit 2pi and eq. (32), which were readable.
